operations.title: The rank-two Kummer line is not independently a physical current
operations.summary: Benincasa Entries 1216-1217 already type the physical five-site object as the marked degree-32 C2^5 cover supported on det(H)=0 and five edge-soft divisors. Nima's w^2=-R line is an exact algebraic incidence subcover, but physical activation still requires a chain/current map.

authority_basis.basis: Inbox reconciliation exposed earlier authoritative physical typing; the exact algebraic claim is retained while its physical interpretation is narrowed.
